text: When learning a new word, meet it in several different sentences rather than repeating one definition; varied contexts help you grasp how it works.
Open-source software shows how people who may never meet can improve shared tools together: Linux, built by a worldwide community, powers computers from phones to supercomputers.
Before making breakfast, inspect the fridge for a wilting herb or leftover vegetable; chop a little into eggs, toast or porridge, using what’s already there.
